semanticChecks: Oral care: teeth/gums/cavity/periodontal disease/odor, bacteria/saliva/taste/appetite support retained, not complete aspiration-pneumonia prevention or no swallowing evaluation. Explanation and oral assessment, low-force incremental cleaning and affected-side residues; observed bleeding/swelling/pain site and person complaint to medical staff. Rinse/spit/posture ability individually assessed with oral/swallow plan, no forced water and responsible staff confirmation. Stable head/posture, no forced chin lift; front eye-level versus rear head support examples not position-only prevention. Aspiration below vocal cords distinct from swallowing dysfunction. Pencil-grip pressure control not safety guarantee; sponge brush indication/specialist/product checks, not equal-to-toothbrush all times, detached sponge abnormalities not used and reported. Removable full/partial and upper/lower dentures, cleaning dentures not whole-mouth completion. Material-specific brush/water/cleaner and dental instructions, residual teeth/mucosa separately cared for. Storage clean container/water/cleaner examples and drying cracks, no independent drying/boiling/unsuitable solution or filing denture; pain/wounds reported.

Bathing: continued body/expression/skin/feelings checks, neck/armpit/groin/feet and actual folds/dirt-prone sites; unmarked diagram areas not exempt. Suitable accompaniment/equipment/fall prevention/privacy covering and assessed hemi helper stance, not universally fixed. Water checked by suitable means plus person heat/discomfort, one staff hand touch not continuing guarantee; hot complaint stops water and prompts renewed check, altered sensation not complaint-only. Peripheral-to-central and unaffected-first pouring example separate from helper stance; actual reaction/facility/equipment/individual method. Appropriate lather/no strong friction/rinse and preserve ability, adjust on pain. Unaffected-first tub entry example with affected floating-side support as needed, stable posture/continued monitoring and no unassisted isolation if help needed. Orthostatic BP-drop dizziness risk, slow individual posture change, abnormality stop bath and seek assistance/medical contact per facility; final water heat checked. Hair wet/lather/finger pads/no scratching nails/eye protection/rinse/comfort. Gentle dry-towel pressing/folds dry/warm clothing/plan moisturizer, moisturizing not leaving folds wet, wound/abnormality not own new-product treatment. Dryer product temperature/distance/air location and staff-hand picture not burn prevention proof, aftercare health/comfort/rest/fluid plan.

Partial/perineal washing: hand and foot bath scopes, reachable basin/comfortable foot container/stable posture and person ability. Warm clean supplies/rinse/dry; no unchanged reuse of other-person or dirty-site water/equipment. Soft nails after bath not permission to cut, nail/skin/disease/instructions and abnormalities to medical staff. Perineal waste/sweat/odor/bacterial possibility, no odor-only infection diagnosis; purpose/method explanation/consent/minimal exposure/privacy and temperature sensitivity, near-body-temperature example not staff sensation/room temperature alone. Explicit female urethral-to-anal direction, no back-and-forth same surface, change clean surface/material to avoid returning anal dirt to urethra. Explicit male scrotal/fold observation, consent/plan/trained method, pain/skin abnormalities to medical staff, no forceful skin/tissue pulling. Gentle drying/redness/pain/wounds and site/person complaint to medical staff. Disposable gloves not dirty-surface clean contact authorization; dirty-to-clean glove removal/hand hygiene/new needed gloves/materials. Lesson context retains unconfirmed specific male procedure warning and no guessing from picture.

ICF: living function/disability/health framework not diagnosis-only ability assignment. Health status, body/mental functions, body structures, activity and participation distinct. Housing/people/community resources-services/attitudes environment may facilitate or obstruct; age/experience/personality/values personal factors, no same-support inference from same diagnosis/age. Bidirectional interrelationships include environment and participation opportunities rather than disease-to-universal incapacity. Original reading-group wheelchair/door case separately records movement, environmental barrier and participation preference, route/help with stakeholders, not person-body-only barrier. Appropriate slope transport example but actual ramp/path/device/ability/wish assessed; sex/age not preference or independence assumptions, purpose/sharing scope/consent and individual plan.

Motor disability: hand-foot/trunk movement and daily/social difficulty, brain/spinal-cord/limb damage and bone/joint/spine deformity/contracture causes retained, no label-only transfer method. Individual site/severity, movement versus comprehension distinct; possible coexisting cognitive/intellectual difficulty does not justify assumed noncomprehension. Cane/wheelchair/prosthesis distinct purposes, lost-limb replacement and person health/ability/life goal/environment fit, adjustment/training not mere possession. Direct person conversation/easy reply method/time and requested family help, no exclusion because hand difficulty. Site/cause/current ability separated; individual plan/facility guidance and no practical transfer/device skill guarantee.

Hearing: loss/difficulty and social participation, ear-brain pathway/site/degree/onset individual, not age/device-only hearing or understanding. Amplification not full restoration or full noise separation, worn device not delivered meaning; ask experience/useful method and specialist adjustment/use. Quiet/front face-mouth visible/better ear when known/slow-clear/no unnecessary loudness; environment/reaction checked. Writing/sign face/hand/lipreading/aid combined individually, usable writing/language/vision/experience/preferences; no universal signing or complete lipreading assumptions. Verify received meaning with low burden. Noisy-room guidance case retains staff only increasing volume, alternative text checked with person, no staff-only device setting change.

Aphasia: broad language impairment versus acquired-language impairment from language-brain damage/stroke, hearing comprehension/speech/reading comprehension/writing differently affected and individually assessed. Sparse speech not no understanding/unwillingness/all cognitive loss; aphasia not speech-muscle-only difficulty, overlap and specialist assessment. Short clear one-at-time speech/wait, no constant small-error interruption; yes/no/options only suitable, no staff convenience response interpretation. Picture/photo/gesture/option board/writing/device by residual ability/wish, cannot assume speech difficulty means writing preserved; team/specialist sharing. Two-activity same-picture stroke case observed speech versus picture response recorded separately, wish verified and one choice not global language assessment. Time for own intent, no invented staff-made wishes; observed reaction/unknowns to responsible staff and plan/specialist instructions.

All7full effective original-project-authored case readings preserve every actor/state/sequence and unknown: denture cleaned but teeth/mucosa not checked; staff hand test then too-hot complaint; gloved anal-surface return toward urethra; wheelchair reading-group door barrier; clear replies but staff family-only question; noisy room guidance not received and volume-only thought; post-stroke sparse speech and consistent one-of-two picture choice. All7questions retain4distinct source-specific options/rationales and exact correct indices. Artcaptions retain context-only limitations, no skill/device-fit/cleanliness/confirmed-intent claims from picture.
